title: Three Weeks and One Short Phrase
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：language　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 language 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the teacher ① learnt the language that no traveller in the town would have recorded, and he said the learning was the whole of the week. The ② language, meaning the tongue itself and not the phrase, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; a language, he said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ language in that town had the same short phrase beside it, and the ④ language at the far door, meaning the word they kept for the children to learn and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A language, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the teacher said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the language was the whole of the matter, meaning the custom and not the tongue. The ⑥ language, meaning the custom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; language, he said, is either something you learn or the only word that means both a tongue and a custom. He said the custom is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ language had become a line in a grammar, and the grammar had become an argument about the short phrase. The ⑧ language of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in October, was one town and three weeks of recording; language, he said, is either the word at the far door or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ language I remember is the tongue recorded in the grammar, which closed in 1978 and is still recorded as the quietest in the town. A ⑩ language, my mother said in 1980, is the only tongue that improves by being recorded; every language, she said, is a custom that has agreed to look like a tongue. She said the custom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 语言；话（指小镇里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 语言；话（指那种语言本身，与短语相对）
C. 固定搭配：learn the language 学会这一种语言
D. n. 语言；话（指留给孩子们学的那个词那一种）
E. n. 言语之事（抽象总称，指一处小镇的语言之事）
F. n. 语言；话（指文法书里写到、被记载的的那一种）
G. n. 习俗、说法（指一件事里人人都说却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: learn the language 意为“学会这一种语言”，1971 年那位教习把小镇里没有一位异乡人肯记载的一种语言做了一遍。
language 意为“语言；话”，指那种语言本身而不是短语，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
language 意为“语言；话”，指小镇里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一个短短的短语。
language 意为“语言；话”，指最远那扇门口留给孩子们学的那个词那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
language 意为“习俗、说法”，指一件事里人人都说却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这套习俗就是那件事的全部。
language 意为“说法”，指人人都说却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种语言，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
language 意为“语言；话”，指文法书里写到、被记载的的那一种，到 1976 年这一种成了文法书里的一行。
language 意为“言语之事”，教习十月写道，整件事的语言之事是一处小镇和三个星期的记载。
language 意为“语言；话”，我记得的是文法书里记载过的那一种，1978 年学成了，至今仍被说成小镇里最安静的一种。
language 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，语言是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的语言。
